svg.title: Appointment dependencies as a stack of stones
svg.desc: Conceptual illustration. Stones drawn with fine contour hatching. Three base stones labelled service, location and date support a long flat stone labelled open times, which supports a stone labelled chosen time. A small stone labelled caller's yes sits on the chosen time. To the right, a standing stone labelled name rises from the ground on its own. A mint capstone labelled booking rests across the caller's yes and the name, so the booking needs a time from the lookup, the caller's agreement and the name, while the name never depended on the lookup.
